edit.ability:
Has no effect until 2 pair turns have ended.
Doubles all time-based and (XPG) ability usage, for example:
(2CD) -> (1CD) 
(1CD) -> (1CD)(2U)
(1PG) -> (2PG)
(1GCD) -> (1GCD)(2U)
